expression_units: Batch-normalized RSEM from Illumina HiSeq RNASeqV2, according to supplied meta_mrna_seq_v2_rsem.txt
correlation: Two-sided Spearman rank correlation; pairwise complete measured beta and RNA values; no methylation imputation; n is pair-specific.
multiple_testing: Benjamini–Hochberg over finite P values for all unique CpG–gene pairs separately within All, African, and White groups.
alignment: Patients matched by normalized explicit TCGA patient IDs; All restricted to the 495-patient manuscript cohort with available RNA. Multiple genomic locations for the same CpG–gene pair are joined and not retested.
original_method_corrections: Original rSquare field contains Spearman rho, not Pearson r or r squared.
Original All correlation cohort included 515 RNA-matched tumours across all clinical race categories; new All cohort is restricted to the manuscript cohort.
Original survival high/low cutoff was zscore(beta)>0, equivalent to above/below the cohort mean, not the median.
Original GSEA used RNA expression, absolute signal-to-noise ranking, KEGG 2019, 1000 phenotype permutations, weighted exponent 1, and gene-set size 15–500.
Original survival workbook includes 49 duplicated full rows among 21887 rows; the unique test count is 21838.
